args.title: Use PUBLIC_URL env var instead of localhost for password reset links
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

The password reset email currently uses a hardcoded localhost URL (`http://localhost:3000`) as the fallback when `PUBLIC_URL` is not set. This causes the reset link to point to localhost, which is unreachable for users outside the development environment. The fix is to ensure the `BASE_URL` always uses `process.env.PUBLIC_URL` without falling back to localhost in production or deployment contexts. This aligns with how the environment variable is intended to be used.
